name: CoinGecko

overview.text: CoinGecko offers crypto market/onchain data through key-based plans and a separate experimental x402 route. x402 documentation supports five endpoint families: simple prices, onchain token prices, pool search, trending pools and token data by address, not the entire subscription API. It lists $0.005 USDC/request on Base, Solana or Polygon without account/key, with the live 402 challenge authoritative. Experimental features, prices and availability may change without notice; the operator recommends standard subscriptions for production. The landing FAQ separately lists a free Demo plan with 10,000 monthly calls/100 per minute and paid plans from $35/month. Those quotas/credits do not apply to x402 purchases. Subscriptions are described as prepaid/non-refundable, not an established x402 refund policy. Coverage, freshness and commercial-use rights depend on endpoint/plan. Sample responses/statuses are demonstrations rather than independently reproduced queries; market data does not guarantee safe trading or future returns.

disclosure: Source: listed on YourAITools (youraitools.co, CC BY 4.0), verified by Commonworld unpaid 402 probe 2026-10-23 (23:37-23:37 UTC). No payment, deal or contact with CoinGecko or YourAITools is involved.
